fact_previews: MONEY is a new play created by Rick Miller.
MONEY is an epic theatre production about money, AI, and the future of humanity.
The play features a cast of 8 of Canada's top theatre stars.
39 backers pledged CA$ 5,331 to help bring the project to life.
The funding period for the project is from June 2, 2024, to August 1, 2024.

fact_previews: The 'MONEY for MONEY' campaign aims to raise $100,000, including $5,000 with Kickstarter.
The funding will pay for 2 development workshops in 2024 and 2025.
The funding will go directly to theatre artists.
The other $90,000 is being raised through a combination of government grants and larger sponsorships.
Backers of the campaign can receive exclusive perks, such as a pdf of the MONEY script and a signed CD.

fact_previews: Rick Miller is a Toronto-based writer, director, performer, musician, educator, and podcast host.
Rick Miller has a 25-year career in the arts, working in six languages on five continents.
Rick Miller has toured for a decade with Robert Lepage & Ex Machina.
Rick Miller has created solo shows including the BOOM Trilogy, MacHomer, Bigger Than Jesus, and HARDSELL.
Rick Miller has created family shows such as Twenty Thousand Leagues Under The Sea, Jungle Book, FRANKENSTEIN: A Living Comic Book, and HANS: My Life in Fairy Tales.
